answer: Agents quoting on a saffron shipment at the jetty or mapping a mesa receive one active job ticket per independently attested secure module each epoch. The market sends a random challenge to the module and binds the ticket to its public key; aliases on the same module share one capacity slot. To flood bids, an attacker must buy or rent more physical modules and keep them online for surprise checks, raising the cost per fake identity. Hardware makers could collude or modules could be rented at scale, so independent attesters and appeals are needed.
